components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Metal fill action on Work and contact.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ececec; color: #070707; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 14px/1 "Public Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4d4d4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ececec; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #ececec; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(236,236,236,0.14); border-radius: 2px; font: 500 14px/1 "Public Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #ececec; color: #070707; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ececec; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Card
components.html:
KitaKo

Private semantic image search that runs on-device.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; color: #ececec; border: 1px solid rgba(236,236,236,0.14); border-radius: 2px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 500 1.85rem/1 Fraunces, serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #9c9c9c; font: 400 1rem/1.55 "Public Sans", sans-serif; }

components.name: Find Trigger
components.css: .ds-find { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: transparent; color: #ececec; border: 1px solid rgba(236,236,236,0.14); border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 11px; font: 400 12px/1 "Public Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-find span { color: #9c9c9c; } .ds-find:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ececec; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pin Title
components.css: .ds-pin { margin: 0; color: #ececec; font: 500 clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4rem)/0.95 Fraunces, serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-variation-settings: "SOFT" 35, "WONK" 1; }

narrative.overview: The Surface is a volume of silver fluid a visitor remembers. Near-black ground, white and silver ink, Fraunces plus Public Sans, 2px metal corners. Canvas UI Liquid lives only in the first viewport; Work is proof, not the costume.

rules.name: One Material
rules.body: Liquid is confined to the first viewport and stays white/silver.

rules.name: One Type Voice
rules.body: Fraunces for display; Public Sans for reading and UI.

rules.name: Tonal Depth
rules.body: Hairlines and plates instead of shadows.

dos: Do keep Liquid silver and first-viewport-only.
Do restyle shadcn Button and Card to Silver Field.
donts: Don't add a second hue or rainbow fluid.
Don't put Liquid on every Work image.
Don't use kickers or section numbers as decoration.
